features.sectionSubtitle: Comprehensive network monitoring solution for macOS power users

items.title: Real-time Speed Monitoring
items.description: Display upload/download speeds in the menu bar. Monitor network status without opening any windows.

items.title: Smart Peak Tracking
items.description: Automatically record daily and historical peak speeds. Analyze data to evaluate if your plan is sufficient.

items.title: Interactive Charts
items.description: Support time ranges from 1 minute to 24 hours. Visualize network usage trends.

items.title: One-click Speed Test
items.description: Integrated Speedtest by Ookla CLI. Professional-grade speed testing and latency analysis.

items.title: Community Leaderboard
items.description: Speed rankings across global, country, and ISP dimensions. See how your network performs.

items.title: Anomaly Detection
items.description: Smart connection monitoring. Instant alerts for disconnections or abnormal speed drops.

items.title: Lightweight & Efficient
items.description: Less than 1% CPU usage, under 50MB memory. Ensures system performance is unaffected.

howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Simple setup, start monitoring your network performance immediately

steps.title: Download & Install
steps.description: Download the DMG file from our website. Drag to Applications folder to complete installation.

steps.title: Configure Your Plan
steps.description: Enter your network plan speed limits. The system will automatically calculate usage and send alerts.

steps.title: Start Monitoring
steps.description: The app displays real-time speeds in the menu bar. Click to view detailed charts and statistics.

speedTest.sectionSubtitle: Integrated Speedtest by Ookla CLI for accurate network speed measurement

items.question: Is Bandwidth ECG free?
items.answer: Yes, Bandwidth ECG is completely free to use with no hidden fees or feature restrictions.

items.question: Which macOS versions are supported?
items.answer: Bandwidth ECG supports macOS 13.0 (Ventura) and later versions.

items.question: Will it affect system performance?
items.answer: No. Our app is optimized with less than 1% CPU usage and under 50MB memory footprint.

items.question: Is my data uploaded to servers?
items.answer: No. All monitoring data is stored locally. We do not collect or upload any user data.

items.question: How do I uninstall?
items.answer: Simply move the app from Applications folder to Trash. To remove all data, also delete ~/Library/Application Support/BandwidthECG folder.
